# itch.io

> > An indie game distribution platform and community hub for independent game developers to publish, distribute, and sell their games directly to players.

itch.io is a marketplace and hosting platform created by leafo that empowers indie developers to share their work. The platform supports game jams, devlogs, analytics tools, and community features like GitHub integration for public issue tracking.

## Key Topics

- indie game distribution
- game jams and jam hosting
- devlogs and patch notes
- game development community
- direct-to-player sales
- platformer games
- interactive fiction
- bug tracking and GitHub integration
- game analytics and CSV export
- community contribution
- indie game releases
- game updates and versioning
- developer tools
- public issues tracker

## Platform Updates & Features

- [Welcome - itch.io](https://itch.io/updates/welcome): Welcome post introducing itch.io indie game distribution platform
- [Jam hosting open for everyone - itch.io](https://itch.io/updates/jam-hosting-open-for-everyone): Game jam hosting now open to all users without admin approval
- [Contribute to itch.io through the public issues tracker - itch.io](https://itch.io/updates/contribute-to-itchio-through-the-public-issues-tracker): Announcing GitHub issues tracker for itch.io feature requests & bugs
- [Enhancing jams: late submissions and entry editor - itch.io](https://itch.io/updates/enhancing-jams-late-submissions-and-entry-editor): New jam admin tools: late submissions and entry editor features
- [CSV export for purchases - itch.io](https://itch.io/updates/csv-export-for-purchases): CSV export now available for purchase data in Game Analytics
